Workload_Assumptions.Target_Workload: Enterprise 25-Step Research, Coding & Financial Approval Agent (500,000 Workflows/Month, 30% Require Async Human Approval, Frequent K8s Deploys)

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Stateless In-Memory `while` Loop Inside FastAPI Worker Pod (Zero State Persistence)
Configuration_Matrix.Persistence_And_Replay: All History & Tool State Held in Process RAM; Pod Restart or Step-19 Error Drops Entire Run
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Single-turn (<5s) stateless chat calls; catastrophic for multi-step or long-running agents

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Celery / Redis Task Queue with Coarse Whole-Workflow Retry on Failure
Configuration_Matrix.Persistence_And_Replay: Queue Retries Entire 25-Step Task From Step 1 When Step 20 Fails; No Step Memoization
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Simple idempotent 1-step background jobs without multi-step LLM chains or human waits

Configuration_Matrix.Persistence_And_Replay: Checkpoint Graph State After Every Node; Native `interrupt()` Hibernation for Human-in-the-Loop
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Flexible cyclic agent graphs, time-travel debugging, and conversational HITL state persistence

Configuration_Matrix.Architecture_Name: Durable Execution Engine (`Temporal / Restate / DBOS`) Wrapping Agent/LangGraph Activities + Deterministic Event Journal & Idempotency Keys
Configuration_Matrix.Persistence_And_Replay: Append-Only Event Log Memoizes Every LLM & MCP Activity; Zero-Resource Sleep for Days; Guaranteed Exactly-Once Side Effects
Configuration_Matrix.Recommended_Scenario: Mission-critical enterprise agents spanning minutes to days with external API writes and human approvals (-53.7% TCO)
